cs1.title: CS-1
cs1.source: modules/cs1: twochannels/CS-1 (cs1.c with its platform include), fm1-dock v0.9.0
cs1.description: A CS-80-style polysynth: two layers, its tone bars, effects and user presets, with velocity and aftertouch from the keys.
cs1.save: Press SAVE, turn PRESETS to pick a slot (U01 to U32), press SAVE again. HOME cancels.
cs1.alt: CS-1's screen: its tone bars and the preset BLADE BRASS

scintilla.title: Scintilla
scintilla.description: The 1981 Elka Synthex with all 80 factory patches, the laser harp among them, checked sample by sample against its browser original.
scintilla.save: Press SAVE, turn PRESETS to pick USR 1 to 12, press SAVE again: the sound as it plays is kept. Any other button cancels. Your sounds come after the factory's on PRESETS.
scintilla.alt: Scintilla's screen: the patch RING MOD., the laser harp

obervave.title: OberVave
obervave.description: A four-track analog-style poly with arpeggiator, sequencer and effects; its pages, presets and patterns live in fm1-dock's banks.
obervave.save: Tap SAVE, turn PRESETS if you want another program number, tap SAVE again within 3 seconds. It replaces the sound at that number. In the sequencer the same two taps save the pattern.
obervave.alt: OberVave's PERFORM page: cutoff, resonance, envelope, release

fm1-sid.source: joakimeriksson/fm1-sid 3210dc1 (FM-1 SID 0.3's code), dock/build.sh with fm1-dock 3cd4e55
fm1-sid.songs: GoatTracker 2's example songs: Dojo, Unleash, Sanction, Consultant, Transylvanian, Hyperspace, Sixpack, Everlasting
fm1-sid.title: FM-1 SID
fm1-sid.description: C64 music: a cycle-exact 6510 and reSID, GoatTracker 2 songs with their editor on the knobs, and any .sid from its page plays at once.
fm1-sid.save: Cannot save: nothing is kept when you leave it or switch off.
fm1-sid.alt: FM-1 SID's screen: Arkanoid by Martin Galway, three voices, the filter, the scope

amb.source: modules/amb: charlesvestal/fm1-amb 7797f4e (AMB-1 1.3 and one commit), fm1-dock 2037c7b
amb.title: AMB-1
amb.description: A generative ambient machine after Music for Airports: pads, bells on tape loops and a gliding bass play themselves while you tend them.
amb.save: Tap SAVE: all eight pieces are saved. It also saves by itself a few seconds after a change, while resting.
amb.alt: AMB-1's screen: the Garden, D Dorian on Dm7, the four layers' levels

fomni.source: modules/fomni: charlesvestal/fm1-fomni 7e7547f (FoMni-1 0.4 and four commits), fm1-dock 2037c7b
fomni.title: FoMni
fomni.description: A chord harp after the Omnichord: chords on the black keys, strummed on the white ones, with a bass and a rhythm box.
fomni.save: Tap SAVE: the sound is saved. It also saves by itself a few seconds after a change, when silent.
fomni.alt: FoMni's screen: the chord C, the strings and the chord buttons

fm106.source: modules/fm106: PatttF/fm-106 db59d58 (FM-106 Beta 6 and one commit; modules/fm106/take.py), fm1-dock f3fdddb
fm106.title: FM-106
fm106.description: The Roland Juno-106: six voices, the 128 factory presets, its BBD chorus, arpeggiator and sequencer; three voices run on the chip's second core.
fm106.save: Tap SAVE for a quick save: a user preset is overwritten, a factory one goes to the first empty user slot. Hold SAVE half a second to choose the slot (SELECT) and the name (ALGORITHM and PRESETS), then SAVE.
fm106.alt: FM-106's screen: the preset A85 Rocket Men, three voices playing, the VCF's sliders and the oscilloscope

monk.source: modules/monk: charlesvestal/fm1-monk a9d368a (MONK-1 0.9.1 and four commits; modules/monk/take.py), fm1-dock 5c44a92
monk.title: MONK-1
monk.description: Twelve singers on MonkSynth's formant voice, each on its own stage: the mouth follows the vowel, and the keys give velocity and pressure.
monk.save: Tap SAVE: every singer's voice is saved. It also saves by itself a few seconds after you stop touching it.
monk.alt: MONK-1's screen: Jerry the monk singing with his mouth wide open, Vowel, Head, Breath and Glide below

fimba.title: FiMba-1
fimba.description: A kalimba by modal synthesis: tines on the white keys, thumb-roll chords on the black, with its body, buzzers, a sound hole's wah, delay and reverb.
fimba.save: Tap SAVE: the sound is saved. It also saves by itself once the sound has rung out.
fimba.alt: FiMba-1's screen: three tines ringing in C major, the chord keys, Material Steel, Hardness, Decay and Tone

gator.title: GATOR
gator.description: A macro-oscillator on Emilie Gillet's Plaits DSP: 24 models in 3 banks, a low-pass gate, two LFOs and an 8-slot modulation matrix.
gator.save: Press SAVE, turn SELECT to pick P1 to P16, press SAVE again. Every preset can be overwritten.
gator.alt: GATOR's screen: the model WAVETABLE, its harmonics, timbre and morph, the wave under them

dub.source: modules/dub: sbegueria/fm1-dub 501c4cf (DUB-1 1.4.3 and five commits; modules/dub/take.py), fm1-dock 9d3aac5
dub.title: DUB-1
dub.voices: 4 chord voices, 6 pings, a bass, 5 drums
dub.description: A generative dub techno machine, AMB-1's fork: chord stabs dissolve in a tape echo over a steady kick, in eight pieces it plays by itself.
dub.save: Hold GLO about a second and let go: all eight pieces are saved (SAVE here opens the Noise pages). It also saves by itself while resting.
dub.alt: DUB-1's screen: the Form page, the chord Fm7 in its ripples, the lanes of the phrase, Energy, Vary, Motion and Drift

prophet.source: modules/prophet: keremimo/melodee e9b07b4 (branch next; modules/prophet/take.py), fm1-dock
prophet.title: PROPHET
prophet.description: A Prophet-5 Rev 4 on Melodee's engine: Poly-Mod, two filter characters, glide, unison and Vintage; INIT and eight patches of its own, and your own bank if you send one.
prophet.save: Cannot save an edited sound yet: it remembers only the patch number. A bank you import as a .syx file (the button on its card) is kept, and shows under Presets.

imports.label: Import .syx…
imports.what: Prophet-5/10 programs, as Sequential's own .syx files: up to 200.
imports.warn: It replaces everything imported into PROPHET before, also when the file holds one program.

prophet.alt: PROPHET's screen: the patch STRINGS, 3 of 8, its MAIN page with cutoff, resonance, envelope amount and release

fm6.title: FM6
fm6.voices: 16, half on the second core (10 on one core)
fm6.description: A DX7-style six-operator FM synth on Melodee's engine: 32 algorithms, feedback, DX7 envelopes and scaling, three renderers; its own 24 voices, and your own DX7 SysEx voices if you send them.
fm6.save: Cannot save an edited voice yet: it remembers only the voice number. DX7 voices you import as a .syx file (the button on its card) are kept, and show under Presets.

imports.label: Import .syx…
imports.what: DX7 voices: a 32-voice bank or single voices, up to 128 in all.
imports.warn: A bank replaces the voices imported into FM6 before; single voices are added to them.

fm6.alt: FM6's screen: the voice TINE EP, 1 of 24, its MAIN page with algorithm, feedback, brightness and mod envelope

b3.title: B3 ORGAN
b3.license: GPL-3.0-only (its organ model after setBfree, GPL-2.0-or-later)
b3.description: A tonewheel organ modelled on setBfree: nine drawbars, key click, vibrato and chorus, percussion, overdrive, reverb and a Leslie; setBfree's 110 programs and its MIDI controllers.
b3.save: No presets: the registration in hand is remembered by itself. Not listed under Presets.
b3.alt: B3 ORGAN's screen: the nine drawbars of Standard B (88 8000 000), vibrato, Leslie, percussion, overdrive and reverb under them

niagara.title: Niagara Drift
niagara.description: A drone synth after the Lyra-8, the Subharmonicon and the DS-2: two drones that breathe and drift, scenes you press into, gestures, a delay and a reverb. Its delay reaches 270 ms here (450 in the original).
niagara.save: Tap SAVE to save everything now; it also saves by itself when the drone is stopped. Hold SAVE and press a lower white key to store a scene (banks A to C).
niagara.alt: Niagara Drift's screen: PLAY 1, SWELL, the two drones' waves, their pitch and cutoff

artihive.title: ARTIHIVE
artihive.description: An experimental drone and polyphonic synth: eight voices as four interacting FM pairs, DRONE and POLY modes, a Hyper LFO, stereo motion, a modulated two-line delay (1 s here), distortion, compression, mutation and an arpeggiator.
artihive.save: Tap SAVE to step to the next user slot (U1 to U8), then hold SAVE about a second and let go: SAVED TO USER.
artihive.alt: ARTIHIVE's screen: DRONE, voice 1, the output's wave, four envelopes, TUNE, FINE, SHARP and MOD, the eight voices' tunings

fmini.source: modules/fmini: ruppert/fmini-1 74375d3 (FMini-1 2.5.13: its FMINI engine, factory patches and effects) and hugelton/Felucca-Engines c46e008 (dsp.c; modules/fmini/take.py), fm1-dock
fmini.title: FMINI-1
fmini.voices: 1 (MONO, LEGATO) or 12 (POLY, half on the second core; 8 on one core)
fmini.description: FMini-1's monosynth in the style of the classic three-oscillator Moogs: three oscillators and noise, the mixer's soft overload, the 24 dB ladder with its own contour, its 200 factory patches and FMini-1's own effects (drive, chorus, delay, reverb). FMini-1's engine, patches and effects with fm1-dock's own interface and arpeggiator: its sequencer is not in the module.
fmini.save: Press SAVE, turn PRESETS to pick the user slot, press SAVE again. Any other button cancels.
fmini.alt: FMINI-1's screen: the patch PAD SWELL, F004 of 200, its FILTER page with cutoff, emphasis, contour and keyboard control

atek303.title: ATEK303
atek303.description: A TB-303 style acid machine with its own pattern generator: press PLAY and a line plays. Generate, mutate and edit up to 64 steps, 14 oscillators, drive, chorus, a synced delay and a plate reverb, 12 factory presets in 32 slots.
atek303.save: Press SAVE, turn PRESETS to pick a slot (1 to 32), press SAVE. Over a used slot it asks OVERWRITE?: turn any knob to YES and press SAVE again. The pattern is saved with the sound.
atek303.alt: ATEK303's screen: the preset COSMIC TRAX playing, cutoff, resonance, env mod and decay, the 16 steps under them

keys.title: KEYS
keys.voices: 24, half on the second core (16 on one core)
keys.description: A clavinet, an electric piano and a piano from physical models: a plucked string after Mutable Instruments' Plaits (Emilie Gillet) with two pickups and a wah, a struck tine into a magnetic pickup that barks when hit hard, two stiff strings over a soundboard; ten presets, the keys' velocity in all three.
keys.save: No presets of your own: the preset and its knobs are remembered by themselves. Not listed under Presets.
keys.alt: KEYS' screen: the preset EP BARK, E.PIANO 2 of 3, the three families, Tone, Decay, Pickup and Volume

esq1.source: joakimeriksson/fm1-esq, ./build.sh site (the stand-in waves: none of Ensoniq's ROMs in it)
esq1.songs: The Entertainer (Scott Joplin, 1902), built in; the SQ-80's factory demos from your own disk dumps, on its page
esq1.title: ESQ-1

links.label: page: real waves and demo songs

esq1.description: Ensoniq's ESQ-1 of 1986: eight voices of three wavetable oscillators into a four-pole filter, its programs (SysEx in), eight tracks over MIDI, and its sequencer. Stand-in waves and one song of its own; its page sends your own wave ROMs and the SQ-80's factory demo songs to it.
esq1.save: Press SAVE once: the program in hand goes into INT at its number (from ROM 5 it replaces INT 5). INT SAVED shows when no note sounds.
esq1.alt: ESQ-1's screen: fourteen-segment characters, the sequencer playing The Entertainer at 84

arp2600.songs: eight sequences for its 1601, and four of your own
arp2600.title: ARP 2600
arp2600.description: An ARP 2600 with its 1601 sequencer: two oscillators, noise and the ring modulator into the 24 dB ladder filter, two ADSRs, the LFO and sample-and-hold, portamento; ten patches in the manner of Jarre's records and four of your own, and sixteen-step sequences that the keys transpose.
arp2600.save: Press SAVE once: the patch goes to its USER slot, and from a factory patch always to USER 1. On the SEQ page SAVE saves the sequence instead.
arp2600.alt: ARP 2600's screen: the patch WARM BASS and the 1601 sequencer's sixteen steps

eminent.title: EMINENT
eminent.description: The Eminent 310 string ensemble through a Small Stone phaser, the string bed under Oxygène and Equinoxe: four registrations, every key sounding, with attack, release, the ensemble chorus and the phaser on the knobs.
eminent.save: No presets of your own: the sound in hand is remembered (SAVE, or by itself after 2 seconds). Not listed under Presets.
eminent.alt: EMINENT's screen: STRINGS 8'+4', with attack, release, chorus and phaser

minipops.source: modules/minipops, fm1-dock (its tables from ai-smarthome's web engine, take.mjs)
minipops.songs: its twenty rhythms, two a key
minipops.title: MINIPOPS
minipops.description: The Korg Mini Pops 7 rhythm box of 1973, worked as the machine is: ten rhythm keys that combine when pressed together, the A / B lever, tambourine, guiro and quijada on top, and its fourteen sounds to strike by hand; built from the service manual and fitted to recordings.
minipops.save: No presets: the rhythm setup is remembered by itself. Not listed under Presets.
minipops.alt: MINIPOPS's screen: the rhythm ROCK 1 at 120 BPM, its ten rhythm keys

ensemble.source: modules/ensemble: its engine from orrery-fm1 (modules/ensemble/take.py), after Caravel 0.11.0's ENSEMBLE; fm1-dock
ensemble.title: ENSEMBLE
ensemble.license: GPL-3.0-only (its DSP blocks from Felucca-Engines: MIT)
ensemble.description: Fourteen string, choir and dark pads in a stereo three-tap ensemble: a morph from strings through choir to dark, tone, the ensemble's depth and rate, the envelope and the registers on the knobs. The pads of ORRERY as a synth of their own, after Caravel's ENSEMBLE.
ensemble.save: No presets of your own: the pad in hand is remembered (SAVE, or by itself after 2 seconds). Not listed under Presets.
ensemble.alt: ENSEMBLE's screen: the pad GLASS CHOIR, its attack, release, register and breath

orrery.songs: seventeen setups, each a band: strings, lead, bass and drums
orrery.title: ORRERY
orrery.license: GPL-3.0-only (the ENSEMBLE pads' DSP blocks from Felucca-Engines: MIT)
orrery.voices: a band: strings, a lead on the keys, bass and drums
orrery.description: The seventies' synths of a Jarre record playing together: the Eminent 310's strings through a Small Stone, an ARP 2600 lead on the keys, a second 2600 with its sequencer for the bass, the Korg Mini Pops 7, a tape echo, an effects box and a reverb, in seventeen setups. A preview. Its ARP 2600, EMINENT, MINIPOPS and ENSEMBLE are also synths of their own here.
orrery.alt: ORRERY's screen: the setup DRIFT running at 75, the LEAD page with cutoff, resonance, glide and level

sine.title: SINE
sine.description: Dinghy's sine, always there: the fallback when a module fails, and the smallest module to copy when you write your own.
sine.alt: SINE's screen: a sine to build on, the note C4

s1vave.source: modules/s1vave: AndrewGG88/S1Vave e837018 (S1Vave 2.0.1: its engine, effects and sequencer; modules/s1vave/take.py), with fm1-dock's own factory bank, fm1-dock
s1vave.title: S1Vave
s1vave.description: An 8-voice synth after the SH-101 and the S-1: saw, pulse with PWM, sub-oscillator and noise, OSC DRAW and OSC CHOP, a 4-pole resonant filter, a riser, chorus, delay, reverb and a step sequencer. S1Vave's engine and pages on fm1-dock, with fm1-dock's own bank of 16 sounds (not Roland's) and room for 83 of yours; unofficial, without its logo.
s1vave.save: Tap SAVE, turn PRESETS if you want another program number, tap SAVE again within 3 seconds. In the sequencer one tap of SAVE saves the pattern.
s1vave.alt: S1Vave's PERFORM page: POLY SAW, program 01, with cutoff, resonance, envelope amount and portamento time
